stem: Two cultivars were switched to the same photoperiod on the same date but show different reproductive morphology. What is the strongest staging approach?
choices: Use actual reproductive morphology with photoperiod and environmental records rather than forcing the same flower-week label
Assume both are at the same biological stage because the calendar matches
Use nutrient concentration as the stage marker
rationale: Calendar date supports context, but actual reproductive development can vary by genotype and environment.
